terms.label: Algebra
terms.definition: The study of mathematical symbols and the rules for manipulating these symbols.

terms.label: Group
terms.definition: A set equipped with an operation that combines any two elements to form a third element while satisfying four axioms: closure, associativity, identity, and invertibility.

terms.label: Abelian group
terms.definition: A group in which the binary operation is commutative.

terms.label: Cyclic group
terms.definition: A group that is generated by a single element.

terms.label: Ring
terms.definition: A set equipped with two binary operations, usually called addition and multiplication, satisfying certain axioms.

terms.label: Field
terms.definition: A ring in which the nonzero elements form an abelian group under multiplication.

terms.label: Vector space
terms.definition: A collection of objects called vectors, which may be added together and multiplied by scalars.

terms.label: Inner product space
terms.definition: A vector space with an additional structure called an inner product.

terms.label: Hilbert space
terms.definition: A complete inner product space, typically infinite-dimensional.

terms.label: Linear operator
terms.definition: A mapping between two vector spaces that preserves the operations of vector addition and scalar multiplication.

terms.label: Matrix
terms.definition: A rectangular array of numbers, symbols, or expressions arranged in rows and columns.

terms.label: Eigenvalue
terms.definition: A scalar such that there exists a nonzero vector which, when multiplied by a matrix, is scaled by that scalar.

terms.label: Eigenvector
terms.definition: A nonzero vector that, when multiplied by a matrix, results in a scalar multiple of itself.

terms.label: Tensor
terms.definition: A multilinear map from vector spaces and their duals to the real numbers.

terms.label: Lie algebra
terms.definition: A vector space together with a binary operation called the Lie bracket satisfying antisymmetry and the Jacobi identity.

terms.label: Representation theory
terms.definition: A branch of mathematics studying abstract algebraic structures by representing their elements as linear transformations of vector spaces.

terms.label: Module
terms.definition: A generalization of a vector space where the scalars are elements of a ring instead of a field.

terms.label: Determinant
terms.definition: A scalar value that can be computed from the elements of a square matrix and encodes certain properties of the linear transformation.

terms.label: Characteristic polynomial
terms.definition: A polynomial associated with a square matrix whose roots are the eigenvalues of the matrix.

terms.label: Unitary matrix
terms.definition: A complex square matrix whose conjugate transpose is also its inverse.
